headline: Has Adobe (ADBE) Fallen Far Enough To Look Undervalued?
summary: Adobe stock has lost around 58% over the past 5 years, yet its current valuation checks still suggest the shares lean cheap rather than expensive, which puts the recent bounce in focus for investors trying to judge where value really sits. Over the past 5 years Adobe has declined about 58%, which means long term holders are still sitting on substantial losses despite the recent rebound.
